sections.title: Welcome to Fitzor Hub
sections.body: This is your home for Fitzor news, practical guides and new ways to shape what comes next. Fresh announcements will appear here automatically—no app update required.

sections.title: Your workout, remixed
sections.body: Fitzor Mix can build a fresh workout around your focus, equipment and session size. Use it once for today or save it as a routine you can return to anytime.
